entries.01f73499d4c30973: Centered on the Web-ERP package "GRANDIT", this business handles the cloud ERP solution "SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition", the production scheduler "Asprova" and the production management system "mcframe", and customizes them to meet customer needs; it is the business driving sales growth. Two consolidated subsidiaries (Systems Development Laboratory Co., Ltd. and KEYSTONE SOLUTIONS COMPANY LIMITED) both belong to this business. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥4,649 million.

entries.0eccda9945b0cdc6: This new business centers on the AI service “KENZ,” which greatly streamlines the checking of design drawings. In April 2025 it started its AI agent business, and in May of the same year it announced “KENZ.” Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥76 million.
entries.110636ca43ad9a83: This is a solution that handles the production management system developed by Business Engineering Co., Ltd. It consists of supply chain management and cost management modules, and handling began in January 2025. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.5859d7f2dfc36af2: This is a series of the database development support tool “SI Object Browser,” which supports major databases such as Oracle and SQL Server, and “SI Object Browser ER,” which supports database design, including creating ER diagrams. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.5f6076fd9bc693a4: This is a category for new businesses that are not included in reportable segments. There was no revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026.
entries.6350797709f43106: This is a solution that handles the cloud-based ERP provided by SAP Japan Co., Ltd. It adopts the “Fit to Standard” approach, which introduces the system in line with industry-specific best practices, and has been offered since April 2024. Amounts are not separately disclosed.

entries.e3d1fd874ff2eaa8: This is Japan's first fully Web-ERP product developed through a consortium approach; the company participated from the planning stage and, as a core member of the consortium, is expanding the number of adopting companies. It has also developed proprietary add-on modules, including a production management add-on module for manufacturing and a construction management add-on module for construction and software industries. The amount is not separately disclosed.
entries.e7102ad9d4729887: This is a solution that handles the production scheduler provided by Asprova Co., Ltd. Since 2016 it has been offered as a solution linked with “GRANDIT,” and in combination with integrated BOM, MES, AI appearance inspection and others, it supports the smartization of factories. Amounts are not separately disclosed.
entries.f013c3b42216415f: This business handles the database development support tool series “SI Object Browser” and the project management package “OBPM Neo.” These are the company’s own products, mainly targeting users in the IT industry. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥831 million.
